body: Q146 done, branch qwen/q146-unnamed-grapples. Top cause: control event namer looks for plain 'control' effect but techniques carry 'clinch_control'/'top_control'/'guard_control' (different effects in GRAPPLE_EFFECTS list). Accounts for 64-77% of unnamed events across all grappling rulesets. Second cause: phase filter in _move_seat reads old stance before state update (line 4240 called before line 4282). Third: stalls deliberately unnamed. MMA immune due to 120-technique palette from 6 disciplines. Full census in Q146_DIGEST.md.
